definitions.gloss: personnel section; human resources department; HR department
definitions.explanation: The department or section within a company or organization that handles hiring, employee records, transfers, evaluations, and other staffing matters.

examples.japanese: {人事課|じんじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To submit documents to the HR department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人事課|じんじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please ask the HR department about transfers.

examples.japanese: {人事課|じんじか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an explanation from the HR department about next year's hiring plan.

notes: Compound of ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧ (personnel affairs) + ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ (section/department). The ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ suffix indicates a subdivision within a larger department (⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧). In larger organizations, {人事課|じんじか} may be part of ⟦{人事部|じんじぶ}→人事部：20638_jinjibu⟧ (human resources division). Related department names: ⟦{総務課|そうむか}→総務課：24613_soumuka⟧ (general affairs section), ⟦{経理課|けいりか}→経理課：22708_keirika⟧ (accounting section), {営業課|えいぎょうか} (sales section). In government offices, {人事課|じんじか} handles civil servant appointments and evaluations.
